extraction_notes: Exact identity verified: LMBT2222ALT1G, LRC, NPN silicon; assigned PDF SHA-256 49cd7f6d63c4b8c8bd26ef1490ec4993b2a8a8f4a1db2e18a9d80b2163b77d77.

The p. 2 DC gain table gives minimum HFE values of 35, 50, 75, 35, 100, 50, and 40 for the listed IC/VCE conditions. At IC = 150 mA and VCE = 10 V, the table also gives a maximum HFE of 300; gain_points records the minimum bound and this maximum is preserved here rather than treated as typical.

The p. 2 saturation table gives VCE(sat) maximums of 0.3 V at 150 mA/15 mA and 1 V at 500 mA/50 mA. VBE(sat) is bounded 0.6 to 1.2 V at 150 mA/15 mA and has a 2 V maximum at 500 mA/50 mA; the required scalar fields preserve one bound per row and these bounds are recorded here.

All electrical-characteristic rows are TA = 25 degC unless a different temperature is stated. ON-characteristic rows use the datasheet pulse test condition: pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2.0%.
Curve points are direct approximate readings from plotted grid positions only; no interpolation was used. The p. 3 and p. 4 plots also contain -55 degC and 150 degC curves, which were not digitized.

The capacitance-versus-reverse-voltage plot and collector saturation-region plot were not digitized; the table provides the required capacitance and saturation inputs. No Early-voltage scalar is emitted because the output plot is a single typical IB family and the strict schema has no VAF field; output conductance remains approximate.

The datasheet also specifies VCBO = 75 V, VEBO = 6 V, continuous IC = 0.6 A, PD = 0.225 W on FR-5 at TA = 25 degC, and storage time ts = 225 ns; these are outside the strict bjt extraction fields except for the VCEO field.
No temperature-dependent, reverse-operation, noise, thermal, or package-parasitic model parameters are extracted.
extraction.omission_reason: The supplied datasheet has usable typical DC, saturation, VBE, fT, and output-characteristic plots, but no robust scalar Early-voltage extraction field; capacitance-versus-bias and collector-saturation-region plots were omitted because the required table rows provide the minimum model inputs. Temperature-dependent, reverse-operation, noise, thermal, and package-parasitic data are not represented by the strict schema.
